import os
os.chdir('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature')
p='src/codegen_support/runtime/strings/mod.rs'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('mod str_replace;','mod str_replace;\nmod str_replace_arrays;',1)
s=s.replace('pub use str_replace::emit_str_replace;','pub use str_replace::emit_str_replace;\npub use str_replace_arrays::emit_str_replace_search_array;',1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/codegen_support/runtime/emitters.rs'
s=open(p).read()
old='    strings::emit_str_replace(emitter);'
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old, old+'\n    strings::emit_str_replace_search_array(emitter);')
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('helper registered and emitted')
PYEOF
